title: NKJV Chronological Study Bible — publisher-block reading plan

chronology.source: Thomas Nelson, The Chronological Study Bible, NKJV (2008)
chronology.method: Order key = printed_page + within_page_scripture_order + passage_boundary, recovered from glyph coordinates in the printed body and cross-checked against the publisher's Index of Scripture Passages and the running head of every page.
chronology.validation: All 787 publisher blocks placed; order strictly increasing; 166/166 tied start-page groups resolved; 31,100 verses each printed exactly once across 1,189/1,189 chapters.

boundary_policy.rule: A reading follows the publisher's own block boundaries exactly, including mid-chapter starts and ends and a/b half-verse divisions.
boundary_policy.rationale: The previous whole-chapter rule guarded against mid-chapter boundaries inferred from page headers without context. These boundaries are the publisher's own, verified in the printed body, so they are carried through unchanged.
never: rounding a publisher boundary to a chapter boundary
splitting inside a verse unless the publisher prints an a/b division

schedule_policy.rest_nights: Friday (intercession) and Saturday (family movie night); the Sabbath runs Friday night to Saturday night

translation_policy: No Scripture translation text is embedded. Readings carry references and OSIS ids only; a text provider supplies the words.
copyright_note: Background-note titles, topic tags and visual titles are bibliographic references to the printed edition. No publisher prose or artwork is reproduced.
